This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, 
which must be performed every three months or 2000 operating hours which comes 
first as indicated by M3 / H 2000 in the title block

The first draft 
 initiated by eng. Mohamed Mohamed Helaly Abd Alkarem and tested by eng. 
 Mahmoud Mohamed Zayed and eng Tarq Mohamed Rashad Ahmed at
 18 Jan 2004, accepted by general director eng. Gaber 
 Desoqy Mostafa, and approved by eng. Mohamed Mahdey Rezq Alnshar Head Sector of Sidi Kirir 
 1&2 Power Station.

A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety healthy, safety shoes

items:
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety healthy, safety shoes

The motor have to be stopped and its breaker isolated before starting any 
 maintenance procedure

Lubricating oil typ : Mobil DTE Heavy medium - ISO - VG 68 ( or equivalent) 
 approximately 75 Liters ( 60 for motor thrust, 15 for Pump thrust) see Note 1.

Grease type : Mobilex EB3 [or Lithium base equivalent Mobil - PLX 
 47] approximately 120 gm for regressing see Note 2.
Packing type: RT-P 4 pieces [ 16mm cross section]
Grease Gun with - capacity 5 kg for changing grease
Grease Gun with - capacity 1 kg for Re-greasing
Torque wrench
Adjustable wrenches - with different sizes
Wrenches with width size (30,24,20)
Feeler gauge { flexible coupling clearance check ].
Mechanical tool kit

sections.text:
Work to be Carried Out 
Drawing (dwg) no. 1001-CP-118-CP5-0004-04

items: Open main motor breaker, tag no. 1NB0206
Turn off DC supply
Open space heater No. 1NHA-12A-CCH-25
Close suction valve No. 1AD-V-021
Close discharge valve No. 1AD-V-027
Close recirc valve No. 1AD-V-136
Close discharge vent valve No. 1AD-V-025
Close seal water valve No. 1AD-V-030

Close pump cooling water 
valve No. 1EB-V-112 & 113
Close motor cooling water valve No. 1EB-V-114 & 115
Open drain valve No. 1AD-V-118

Check for oil color, quality and Taking sample for analysis 
 change if required.
Check for oil level. Top up if required.
Lower bearing type - NU 238.
Check for grease quality and color Change if required

Flushing and cleaning for oil cooler if required. Flushing 
 water pressure < 6 bar

General cleaning and inspection for cooling water and oil connection lines for 
 leakage (tighten if required)
Check for oil color, quality and take a sample for analysis, change if required.

Check for oil level and top up if required to the middle of 
 side glass.

Flush and clean the oil cooler if required. Flushing 
 water pressure < 6 bar.

General cleaning and inspection for cooling water and oil 
 connection lines for leakage (tighten if required)
Check backing and change if required

Tight fit the gland (M 16 Bolts) if required or tight fit 
 by hand only.
Check for clearance at the coupling using feeler gauge [ S=7-4+1]

Check for maximum permissible wear of flexible parts {wear value should not 
 exceed 7mm.s}
Change flexible parts if required.
Check tightened parts
Check tightening torque between :
Motor and motor stool
Motor stool and discharge elbow
Discharge elbow and foundation ring
Upper and lower halves of coupling

Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, 
which must be performed every three months or 2000 operating hours which comes 
first as indicated by M3 / H 2000 in the title block
The first draft 
 initiated by eng. Mohamed Mohamed Helaly Abd Alkarem and tested by eng. 
 Mahmoud Mohamed Zayed and eng Tarq Mohamed Rashad Ahmed at
 18 Jan 2004, accepted by general director eng. Gaber 
 Desoqy Mostafa, and approved by eng. Mohamed Mahdey Rezq Alnshar Head Sector of Sidi Kirir 
 1&2 Power Station.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety healthy, safety shoes
